scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/flint typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/www typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/flint build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd apps/www build
scripts.verify: bun run registry:check && bun run contrast && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test && bun run linkcheck
